Exact means and both covariances agree for all ten cases 3≤r≤n≤6; at (3,3) the covariances are 2/15 and −1/15, and at (6,6) they are 2/2079 and −1/2079. No frozen script executed.
correctness.rationale: In the uniform ranked-endpoint model each matching has 2^n n! labeled realizations. A specified r-set has either exact pattern with probability p_r=1/(2r−1)!!. Conditional on the internal ranks, one outside arc crosses a rank-gap-d inside arc with probability d(2r+1−d)/binom(2r+2,2), by counting placements of its two endpoints among the 2r+1 gaps. Complete crossings have d=r. Nestings average this expression over d=1,3,…,2r−1 because label ranks are exchangeable; the sum of d(2r+1−d) is r(r+1)(2r+1)/3, giving exactly 1/3. Disjoint candidate pairs are independent. The r(n−r) pairs sharing one arc hence give covariance p_r(r−1)/(3(2r+1)) each for crossings and zero for nestings. The binom(r,2) contained pairs are forced to cross or not, giving 2p_r/3 and −p_r/3, respectively. Multiplying by binom(n,r) and simplifying yields both stated formulas, including n=r and the signs. This checks the repaired proof as well as its unchanged formulas.
residual_risks: The finite replay does not certify untested sizes; those follow from the inspected arbitrary-r overlap argument.
